description: Required Q4 coverage: rising frustration. A customer with a payment problem is bounced around; irritation builds across turns rather than appearing in one sharp phrase, which is why this needs the LLM layer and not just a keyword.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Good morning, this is Anaya, an AI assistant from the collections support team. This call is recorded. I'm calling about the instalment due on your account.

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Yes, I know. I already spoke to someone about this last week.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: I see. The instalment is showing as pending. When can we expect the payment?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: I explained this already. Business has been very slow this season, I don't have the money right now.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: I understand. Can you make the payment by the fifth of this month?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: This is the third time I'm telling someone the same thing. Nobody is listening. I said I don't have it.

script.speaker: agent
script.text: Right. So can I note down the fifth as the payment date?

script.speaker: customer
script.text: Are you even listening to me? This is a complete waste of my time. Every week somebody calls and asks the same question.
